scripts.build:apk: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 CI=true NODE_ENV=production npx expo run:android --variant release --no-build-cache
scripts.build:release: npm run build:apk && npm run apk:path
scripts.bundle:android:release: mkdir -p android/app/src/main/assets && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npx react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.ts --bundle-output android/app/src/main/assets/index.android.bundle --assets-dest android/app/src/main/assets
scripts.clean:android: node -e "const fs=require('fs');['android/app/.cxx','android/app/build','android/build','android/.gradle'].forEach(p=>{try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Removed',p)}catch(e){}});console.log('Done. Run npm run android or npm run build:apk-debug to build.')"
scripts.apk:path:
echo '
📦 Release APK location:
android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

✅ This APK is standalone (no Metro needed).

Install with: npm run apk:install
Or copy to device and install manually.
'
